scientific_integrity: A complete analytic argument is presented with separately replayable symbolic and numerical consistency tests. The result has undergone same-model review only; publication precedence is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only a fixed scalar strongly convex quadratic with independently Bernoulli-selected current or one-step-stale gradients, deterministic initial pairs and unscaled classical heavy-ball updates. Exact mean-square stability and maximum permissible stepsize, not a convergence-rate optimum. Does not cover correlated delays, adaptive steps, additive noise, vector Hessians or network packet-arrival queues.
title: A quarter-delay phase transition for sharp mean-square stability of momentum with stale gradients
